scripts.build: npm run sync:static && npm run build:wallets && npm run build:payment && npm run build:world

scripts.build:world: node scripts/clean-world-bundle.mjs && esbuild src/world-3d.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=TuringWorldRuntime --outfile=world-runtime.js && node scripts/copy-world-bundle.mjs
